objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has discovered and enumerated network shares using `net use` with corresponding sequential drive letters from A through Z.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also enumerated network shares using Windows APIs to include `WnetOpenEnumW`, `WNetEnumResourceW`, and `WNetCloseEnum`.(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
